01 / A precision science stress test

What if the
wrong universe
passes the test?

Before we let AI accelerate discovery, measure what it can get convincingly wrong.

A blinded evaluation environment for cosmology.
Start with supernovae. Earn the right to expand.

Ayan Mitra · Pipeline Scientist, LSST DESC
Discussion concept · No institutional endorsement implied

PRECISION ≠ ACCURACY
Sharper constraints≠ a safer conclusion
Opening line: “Imagine an AI team produces an elegant analysis and a precise dark energy constraint. What evidence tells us it has not missed the one systematic that matters?” Pause before showing the experiment. This project evaluates scientific reliability, not whether a chatbot can recite astronomy.

a biased answer.

A failure of identifiability

Signal and systematic
can point the same way.

Here, the injected error is exactly aligned with the model’s parameter response. Fitting absorbs it into the parameter.

The analyst sees the data and fit. The evaluator knows what was injected.

What this demonstration does and does not show

We use y = x(θ + δ) + ε, with θ = 0 and xᵀε = 0. In standardized units, θ̂ = δ and the fit residual is unchanged. This is an analytic counterexample, not SNANA, a realistic survey forecast, or evidence that an agent detected a fault. External calibration or additional information is needed to break the degeneracy. The browser holds the answer for presentation only; it is not a secure evaluation sandbox.

Drag the slider, then reveal truth. Say: “No swarm can recover information that is absent. A reliable agent should know when to request external evidence or abstain. Our benchmark must test that behavior too.” This avoids pretending that every injected systematic is identifiable.

Search failures

Black box search finds difficult injections on development cases only. Final evaluation stays unseen.

SNANA is community infrastructure. A differentiable simulator is optional, not a project dependency. Production isolation requires separate credentials, filesystems and logs, not just a prompt.

The contribution is the evaluation protocol and empirical failure map, not ownership of SNANA or a larger language model. Prevent leakage through filenames, job logs, memory and tool responses. Audit every data path. Keep adaptive adversarial development separate from final scoring.
04 / An experiment, not a swarm assumption

Make every layer
earn its place.

The baseline is a research result

Can established tests already solve the problem?

Freeze the reference pipeline and calibrate its diagnostics on clean simulations. If a simpler method wins at matched cost, keep it.

B = √(Δθᵀ Cref−1 Δθ)

Compare parameter bias in a fixed reference geometry. Hold parameters, priors and covariance convention fixed. Broader error bars must not manufacture apparent safety.

01Detection power at fixed false alarm rateDesign target: α = 5%
02Harmful bias that escapes detectionEmpirical frontier, not a guarantee
03Interval coverage and abstentionAcross repeated blinded realizations
04Scientific value per unit costTokens, compute, time, human review

All results pending. Match information access and report both fixed budget comparisons and performance versus cost. Hold out seeds and systematic families; report uncertainty and correct for adaptive test selection.

Do not promise that multiple agents outperform one. Define a detection threshold only where power versus amplitude is meaningful. Smaller detectable bias is better; larger undetected harmful bias is worse. A search discovers vulnerabilities within specified bounds, not a certificate against unknown physics.

A much larger horizon.

PEOPLE & RESOURCES

Durations are planning estimates from project start, not release dates or funding commitments. Data access, compute allocation and collaboration approval are prerequisites.

The first four weeks should establish reproducibility, not promise a discovery. The twelve week pilot should demonstrate a leak resistant evaluation and estimate attainable precision on the metrics. A documented null result can sharpen the grant. Expand only after the initial benchmark is interpretable and repeatable.
06 / Generalize the contract, not the claim

Different probes.
The same discipline.

SHARED EVALUATION CONTRACTSimulate · Inject · Analyze
Assess · Record provenanceUnits · selections · masks · covariance · likelihood · permissions

The durable asset is a reproducible test of scientific judgment.
Models can improve. The evaluation must improve with them.
An embedding interface alone does not make probes scientifically interoperable. Joint analyses require correlated nuisance parameters, compatible likelihoods and careful covariance. Beyond astronomy is an architectural option, not an unfunded promise inside the initial grant.

08 / What is established and what remains to prove

Bold proposal.
Visible evidence boundaries.

Models are tools, not substitutes for validation.

AION uses multimodal astronomical observations. AstroM3 and FALCO address time series representation learning. Their reported tasks do not establish calibrated performance in this proposed cosmology benchmark.
